messages:
matt.ae: Heads up — Helios Energy POC asking for a pre-auth license addendum and clarified e-sign routing before they can sign the order form. They want KMS key escrow language and a one-off SLA uplift for the POC window. Can legal + billing advise?
rebecca_legal: can you paste the exact clauses they want changed? quick skim — is this just DPA/KMS wording or an MSA amendment? :thinking_face:
jordan_se: From the tech side they need isolation for logs and a clause that we won’t use PII for model training during the POC. Also requested dedicated ingest endpoint and a quantitative latency SLO for demo hours.
nash (via ops_deploy_bot): deploy-notice: POC sandbox env for helios created: sandbox-helios-2026. Secrets stored in KMS-secondary.
ash (ops_deploy_bot): added `helios-poc` tag to infra, attaching runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/helios-poc
matt.ae: Rebecca — pasted below the client's sample language delivered by underwriting (they want the addendum attached to the OF):

```
OrderForm: HEL-POC-0426
Requested Addendum: Pre-Authorization License Addendum
- Add: "Customer-managed KMS support via BYOK; Redwood will accept AES-GCM keys via our HSM gateway."
- Add: "During POC period (30 days), Redwood agrees to 99.5% uptime for the dedicated demo endpoint (excluding scheduled maint)."
- Add: "Redwood will not retain model training artifacts originating from Customer input for the purpose of model updates."
- Billing: Net45; invoice split 50/50 initial activation + usage after POC.
```

ashley_billing: Net45 and split invoice is fine for enterprise, but finance needs PO number and an approval matrix. who is the approver at Helios? we also need to confirm if activation fee is taxable in their region.
rebecca_legal: KMS BYOK language — we can accept BYOK but prefer to reference our KMS integration guide and a standard security addendum. i'll propose: "Redwood supports customer-provided keys through an agreed onboarding flow and will not export keys from the customer's KMS." That avoids escrow commitments.
rebecca_legal: SLA uplift — we can do a POC-specific SLO (30 days) but want it scoped: include demo hours and exclude load-testing or third-party vendor-induced outages. Also need escape / rollback language if demo affects production.
jordan_se: Client is asking for a short testing window of elevated throughput during the demo on 05/10. Can ops confirm capacity and any extra costs? :eyes:
ops_deploy_bot: capacity-check: sandbox-helios-2026 currently maps to 2x p4d cores reserved. Estimated incremental cost for demo burst (~6 hours) = $420.
nash (ops_deploy_bot): To guarantee the SLO during demo hours we recommend a temporary reserved capacity slot; ops can approve if finance signs the activation charge.
matt.ae: Next steps I suggest: Rebecca draft a 1-pager addendum we can attach to OF, Ashley confirm billing/PO flow and send estimated activation charge to client, Jordan coordinate demo hours with ops. I'll update Helios.
nash (ops_deploy_bot): quick template for addendum placement in OF: `Attachments -> Special Terms -> Pre-Authorization Addendum`
nash (ops_deploy_bot): suggested OF snippet to send to client below.

```
Special Terms (to be attached to Order Form HEL-POC-0426):
1) Pre-Authorization License Addendum (30-day POC): Redwood agrees to provisions for BYOK onboarding as described in the Redwood KMS Onboarding Guide.
2) POC SLA: For scheduled demo windows (maximum 72 hours total), Redwood will provide a 99.5% availability target as defined in Exhibit A.
3) Data Usage: Redwood will not use Customer-provided content derived during the POC for model training or improvements.
4) Billing: Activation fee and 50% split invoicing described in billing schedule.
```

ashley_billing: sending estimate to client now — putting activation + demo burst as a separate line item so procurement can PO it. also cc'ing finance for tax review.
rebecca_legal: i'll draft the minimal addendum and include fallback language for rollback + metrics. expecting a draft by EOD.
sam_engineer: FYI — for the BYOK flow we need the client to provide key metadata and a signed acceptance of KMS onboarding steps. I'll prepare a one-pager for them.
matt.ae: Great. @rebecca_legal @ashley_billing @jordan_se — please flag any blockers. If legal needs to escalate, ping me and i'll schedule an exec review with their procurement.
rebecca_legal: no blockers anticipated. will include SOC2 references and our standard DPA cross-reference.
nash (ops_deploy_bot): reminder: tag the final OF as `helios-poc-final` when uploading to DocuSign to ensure proper routing to sales-ops.
nash (ops_deploy_bot): docs route: Sales -> Legal -> Finance -> ExecSig (if > $250k)
matt.ae: thanks everyone — i'll loop in Helios with the proposed addendum + PO guidance. will post the client response here. :thumbsup:
heath_client (via email forwarded): "Thanks — please share the addendum and final priced OF asap. procurement needs the signed OF by 05/03 to lock demo date."
matt.ae: replied to client: "We will deliver draft addendum by EOD and a priced OF within 24 hours."
rebecca_legal: draft uploaded to /legal-drafts/helios_poc_addendum_v1.docx — preview link: https://legal.redwood/preview/helios_poc_addendum_v1
ash (ops_deploy_bot): ops confirmed demo burst reservation pending PO. once PO comes in ops will finalize capacity.
ashley_billing: created invoice estimate: INV-HELIOS-0426-DRAFT. sending to client and copying procurement.
matt.ae: closing loop — thanks team. will update thread when signed.
